newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends down on lower interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends down on lower interest rates.

text.p: * Central Bank seen out of the market
Lower domestic interest rates and $50 million worth of corporate requirement pulled down the Philippine peso to close at 26.279 from 26.277, traders said.
The day's average was at 26.281 versus the previous day's 26.276, with volume rising to $137.90 million from $99.70 million.
"The dollar was stronger because overnight rates had gone back to normal levels," said a dealer from a big bank.
